notes.title: Captain Velvet Meteor: The Jump + Dimensions is scheduled for release on March 1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43342480/3bbfe4043ec1a8c721e80d2e777d2ae442040eec.png[/img]


"Captain Velvet Meteor" is set to launch on Steam®, Xbox Series X|S, and Windows on March 1st! Along with this release, the Steam page has received a fresh redesign. 

Initially launched for Nintendo Switch™ on July 28, 2022, this tactical adventure game immerses players in an imaginary world where they transform into "Captain Velvet Meteor" and join forces with characters from "Shonen Jump+" to overcome various challenges.
